# K North Technologies

> Edmonton IT support company: Microsoft 365 and Copilot setup for small businesses, plus ongoing IT support and a monthly helpdesk. Founded by Keita Linton, based in Edmonton, Alberta.

## Services and pricing
- Copilot Quick Start: $1,495 for up to 15 staff, done in about 2 weeks
- Readiness Check: $750
- Workshop: $1,200
- Monthly AI and Microsoft 365 Helpdesk: $350–$600/month, cancel any time
- No long contracts

## What it does
- Security and readiness check, clean Copilot setup, and a hands-on staff workshop built around a team's real daily tasks
- Ongoing IT support and a monthly helpdesk for Edmonton small businesses
- AI support, AI training, and custom AI builds
